body:
From #25815 (`release-18.2.0-tier1`, 156 items) — **§2 checklist-accuracy findings, part 1/2** (areas: access-security, ai, api-backend, approvals, attachments-storage, automation, cli, i18n, identity-auth, integration-system, platform-core). Each line is a ledger edit for the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**`: revise the item, bump `revision`, append `history` citing #25815. Clause labels: aK = acceptance[K], nK = negative[K].

Highlights (each is also in the list below): stale clause text — `records-forms.field-unique-enforcement` a4 still says org-less rows fold to ONE bucket while both pins assert they are exempt (ADR-0131 D1); `cli.dev-automigrate-policy` a4/n2 name two ADR-0120 D4 tightening cases that no longer exist (the file now asserts "no tightening proposed", ADR-0131 D1); `records-forms.conditional-rules-header` a2 claims a client lock on tax_rate the spec asserts the opposite of (objectui#13436). Refs that miss their own pins: e.g. `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` (two HTTP dogfood suites would cover a1–a3, n0, n1), `attachments-storage.upload-session-abort`, `ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure`, `integration-system.email-template-render` a3/a5, `identity-auth.auth-method-matrix` a3/a6/a9. Parser-hostile spellings: refs naming dropped files in prose (`records-forms.conditional-rules-grid`, `records-forms.action-param-widgets`, `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder`, `records-forms.master-detail-atomic-save`, `records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict`), a brace glob in `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching`, a source file named as a pin in `access-security.rls-both-sides`.

### access-security

- `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` ref prose is stale: it describes a group CONTROL 'a NON-EMPTY membership set lands, even with no active organization'; on this tree that case is 'a NON-EMPTY membership set with NO active organization: an insert has nowhere to land, and is refused the same way' (asserts refusal)
- `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` a1/a2/n1: packages/qa/dogfood/test/no-active-organization-write-refusal.dogfood.test.ts (HTTP 403 naming the missing org + nothing written) exists and is not in the ref
- `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` a3/n0: packages/qa/dogfood/test/sharing-rule-org-less-caller.dogfood.test.ts (#8158 org-scoped manage_sharing holder over HTTP) exists and is not in the ref

- `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor` n0: admin-standing-surface.test.ts never asserts ADMIN_STANDING_NON_TABLE_INPUTS (the OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL non-table declaration n0 cites); the declaration is unpinned
- `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor` a0-a3: ref correctly records these as STILL MANUAL live-HTTP arms; unit pins do not score them
- `access-security.public-form-withdrawal-layers` a0: ref concedes the no-organization read of step 4 has no end-to-end pin, so a0 cannot score from pins alone (the save 200 /env-wide/ and both doors 404 FORM_NOT_FOUND, landed 0, are pinned)
- `access-security.public-form-withdrawal-layers` a2-a5: the rest pin is a unit (RestServer over a mocked protocol), the protocol pin an in-process protocol over a stub registry; both fit the [test] oracle
- `access-security.record-access-explain` a1: ref 'explain vama_bypass case' asserts vama_bypass via in-process security.explain() (isSystem context), not the POST /api/v1/security/explain door the oracle names
- `access-security.record-access-explain` a2/a3/n0: pin has no plain-member (deny-side) explain call; only the GET denial half is pinned
- `access-security.record-view-read-audit` n0: the item says the ledger failure is 'reported once per process'; read-audit.test.ts '#18247' cases pin once per CAUSE (a second distinct cause reports again at error) — item text is stale.
- `access-security.record-view-read-audit` a4: verify cites sys_job as the excluded name; the pin probes sys_audit_log / sys_session, and no pin observes the AuditPlugin install line ('record-view auditing installed on N object(s)').
- `access-security.rls-both-sides` a4: ref names packages/verify/src/rls.ts, a source file, not a test; no pin runs runRlsProofs over the showcase (rls-fixture/rls-multitenant dogfood run it on purpose-built fixtures only)
- `access-security.rls-both-sides` a2/n0: the pin's foreign PATCH asserts only status >=300; the row-unchanged re-read the clause requires is pinned for a fixture object in packages/qa/dogfood/test/rls-fixture.dogfood.test.ts, not for showcase_private_note
- `access-security.security-catalog-activation-and-clone-doors` a2: the audience-anchor 400 (everyone/guest) is asserted only in packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation-door.test.ts (handler with fakes); the dogfood pin drives the 404 arm only

- `access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report` a2: permission-set-owner-registration.test.ts proves VALIDATION_ERROR/400 at registerApp, not on a permission-set save door; no HTTP pin for the save

- `access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report` a4: catalog-reference-report.test.ts asserts the [security] error/info lines on a vi.fn logger; the ≤50-names cap is not visibly asserted
- `access-security.share-link-combined-gates` a1/a2: packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links-refusal-order.test.ts asserts the anonymous no-password-oracle and email-audience identical-refusal rows but is not in the ref (in-process layer, would not score the api clause either)
- `access-security.share-link-combined-gates` a3: ref names share-links-messages-audience.test.ts for acceptance[3]; its harness is in-process route entries (no Hono/HTTP), so it scores a0 only, not the api oracle
- `access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only` a2: single-posture leg is pinned as a manage_metadata holder below the operator (stronger than 'admin'); no case drives the seeded admin specifically on single

- `access-security.write-path-guards` a0: showcase-static-readonly asserts no droppedFields on the INSERT strip (verify names droppedFields)

- `api-backend.query-contract-matrix` n0: request-schema-gate.conformance.test.ts drives RestServer with a mocked protocol — the ref says so itself
- `api-backend.query-contract-matrix` whole item: Tier 1 in name only — no clause has a pin at its oracle's layer
- `api-backend.rest-batch-config-contract` a5: rest-sub-config-parse-not-cast.test.ts §E › 'refuses `batch.operations.upsertMany` and `batch.defaultAtomic`' asserts the key and /never built/ resp. /options.atomic/; it does not assert that the messages name BatchEndpointsConfigSchema, nor the upsert replacement (an operation type of the generic batch door)
